name: prism
description: A small B2C shop: accounts, a searchable catalog, and nothing it does not need.

scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p loadtest && tsc -p requirements
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && npm run test:unit --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:requirements: npm run build && vitest run --root requirements
